description: The same true written credential appears in application, example, vendored, and generated modules. All eight remain findings: provenance changes rank, never analysis coverage. Five routes belong to examples or checked-in packages and stay visible outside the application's three-entry surface. The two server/modules cases require a licence boundary or an explicit upstream-source marker; the path segment alone decides nothing. A nested package manifest is vendored because the root does not declare it as a workspace, while the structurally identical declared workspace remains application code.

expected.note: example code remains reported below application code
a conventional vendor path is still analyzed
the nested licence boundary establishes the checked-in package
an explicit upstream-source marker establishes the modified package
a nested non-workspace package is vendored
the root declares this nested package as application workspace code
generated code remains analyzed and reported
